messages.subject: repeated sampling raptor surveys
parts:
I need help with data setup and analysis of raven & raptor surveys. I have data
for 2 years, at the same point transects, surveyed several times a month for 7
months. Three transects make up one study area and I need a density estimate
for each year; 1 transect is a control which I need an estimate for each year.
So far, I have each species as a different data project and I've tried the
transects at Stratum Layer, months and years at Sample Layer, but I can only
get decent estimates on CDS by stratifying at Stratum for each transect both
years combined. I'm confused if I should use post-stratification, or multiple
covariates, or something else. Sample size is a problem, hence the repeated
sampling. Looking for advice from a similar situation, or in general. Please
reply to Wendy at lamm...@unr.nevada.edu, and I will summarize any discussion
for the list. Thanks.
